Universal PDF Vision Parser Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of a high-end, multilingual PDF digitizer for language learning documents.
- Uses multimodal vision (Qwen-VL-Max) to extract and structure content from complex layouts into Markdown.
- Supports multiple languages including French, German, Japanese, and Spanish.
- Converts PDF pages to high-resolution images for accurate text parsing and formatting.
- Perfect for extracting language notes, bilingual documents, and hard-to-capture formats.
